meta.title: Atelier
meta.description: Atelier is a personal Windows desktop studio for builders who run several AI agents in one window, with memory, a browser and meeting notes on your laptop.

hero.title: One studio for every AI agent you run.
hero.sub: Atelier puts your AI agents on one desk, with memory, a browser and meeting notes that stay on your laptop.

scrollWords.label: Why Atelier
scrollWords.text: Less switching between apps. More finishing

bento.title: Built around the way work actually moves
bento.body: Atelier keeps a project's people, files, and decisions close together, so context survives the hand-off.

items.title: Agents in context
items.body: Each agent works with the files and history you hand it, not a blank chat.

items.title: One thread
items.body: Conversations, documents, and tasks stay together, so you can pick the work back up later.

items.title: Memory you can see
items.body: What the workspace remembers is visible, and you decide what stays.

items.title: Quiet by default
items.body: Motion, sound, and notifications wait until you ask for them.

features.title: Small things that keep you in flow
features.body: The parts you touch every day, finished properly.

items.title: Keyboard first
items.body: Move through the workspace without leaving the keys.

items.title: Command palette
items.body: Find files, agents, and actions from a single input.

items.title: Tasks with structure
items.body: Turn a conversation into a task with an owner and a due date.

items.title: Living documents
items.body: Write and edit in the same place the work happens.

items.title: Two languages
items.body: English and Bahasa Indonesia, with the same content on both.

items.title: Accessible defaults
items.body: Reduced motion, visible focus, and readable contrast out of the box.

workflow.title: From a task to a result, without leaving the window

steps.title: Describe the work
steps.body: Start from a task, a file, or a question.

steps.title: Work with agents
steps.body: Agents pick up the context and work alongside you.

steps.title: Keep the result
steps.body: Outputs stay in the workspace, next to the conversation that produced them.

privacy.title: Yours, on your machine
privacy.body: Layers of protection that don't depend on our servers, because there aren't any.

points.title: App lock
points.body: Your password is hashed with scrypt, sessions are HttpOnly, and the app locks itself when idle.

points.title: Encrypted login vault
points.body: Site passwords are encrypted on this device and are never sent to an AI model.

points.title: Local meetings
points.body: Audio is transcribed on your device with Whisper. Backups are encrypted with AES-256-GCM when you set a passphrase.

download.title: Get Atelier
download.body: Windows today. More platforms when they're ready.
download.note: Windows may show a SmartScreen prompt if the installer isn't code-signed yet.
download.otherBody: Windows is the only supported platform for now.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.body: Short answers about how Atelier works.

items.a: A Windows desktop studio where you run several AI agents with shared memory, a browser, QA and meeting notes.
Claude, OpenAI/Codex, Antigravity, DeepSeek, OpenCode and OpenRouter. You use your own accounts or API keys.
On your computer. Atelier has no cloud account. Your chosen AI provider still receives what you send in a chat.

items.q: Do passwords go to the AI?
items.a: No. Saved site passwords are encrypted locally and are not sent to models.
Whisper runs on your device. You download the engine and a model once, then audio is transcribed locally. Atelier asks before recording.

items.q: Can agents run commands on my computer?
items.a: Only if you enable shell access per project. They act with your user's permissions.

items.q: Is there a Mac or Linux version?
items.a: Not yet. Windows is the only supported platform for now.
Atelier checks GitHub Releases for new versions.

closing.title: Step into your studio
closing.body: Everything your agents need, on one desk.
